maxMovedCrates.description: Most crates the player can move at once, counting what they carry.

pushSpeedByCrateCount.description: Player movement speed when pushing that many crates.

customerPushClaimMs.description: How long a shopper's claim on crates lasts without renewal.

customerPushReach.description: How close a loose crate must be before a walking shopper can push it.

customerCrateStuckMs.description: How long a shopper waits before squeezing past a crate that will not move.

customerCrateSqueezeMs.description: How long a shopper squeezes past after getting stuck behind a crate.

physicsFrameDeltaCapMs.description: Maximum time step used when resolving crate pushes after a long frame.
